H2	直接的游戏影响
P	The following works directly inspired <i>Stonetop</i>'s mechanics, techniques, setting, themes, and approach to information design.
B	<i>Dungeon World</i>, Adam Koebel & Sage LaTorra, Sage Kobold Productions, 2012
B	<i>Apocalypse World</i>，D. Vincent Baker 与 Meguey Baker，lumpley games，2010
B	<i>Storming the Wizard's Tower</i>, D. Vincent Baker, unpublished, 2008
B	<i>Dungeons & Dragons</i> (4th Edition), Rob Heinsoo, Andy Collins, and James Wyatt; Wizards of the Coast, 2008
B	<i>Blades in the Dark</i>，John Harper，Evil Hat Productions，2017
B	<i>Beyond the Wall and Other Adventures</i>, John Cocking & Peter S. Williams, Flatland Games, 2013
B	<i>The Perilous Wilds</i>，Jason Lutes，Lampblack & Brimstone，2016
B	<i>20 Dungeon Starters</i>, Marshall Miller & Mark Tygart, Lampblack & Brimstone, 2016
B	<i>Trilemma Adventures</i>，Michael Prescott，Trilemma Adventures，2019
B	<i>Ars Magica</i>, Mark Rein-Hagen & Jonathan Tweet, Lion Rampant Games, 1987
H2	博客
P	You can find a lot of writing about <i>Stonetop</i> and its development at Jeremy's blog, <i>Spouting Lore</i> (2018-2023). Additionally, the following essays and series either influenced techniques and approaches presented in this game or demonstrate the game in action.
B	"<i>Apocalypse World</i>: Crossing the Line," John Harper, <i>The Mighty Atom</i>, 2010
B	"Paint the Scene," Jason Cordova, <i>The Gauntlet Blog</i>, 2018
B	"The 7-3-1 Technique," Jason Cordova, <i>The Gauntlet Blog</i>, 2018
B	“A 16 HP Dragon”，Stras Acimovic，由 Sage LaTorra 转载，Latorra.org，2012
B	"Powered by the Apocalypse" (12-part series), D. Vincent Baker, <i>lumpley games</i>, 2019-2025
B	<i>A Collection of Unmitigated Pedantry</i>, Bret Devereaux, 2019-present (especially the "Practical Polytheism" series and the "Iron, How Did They Make It?" series)
B	"Xandering the Dungeon," Justin Alexander, <i>The Alexandrian</i>, 2010
B	“Dungeon Checklist”，Arnold K.，<i>Goblin Punch</i>
B	"PTFO: Stonetop" (solo actual-play series), SGH, <i>PTFO</i> on Substack, 2022-present
H2	参照作品
P	There's no one thing you can point at and say "<i>Stonetop</i> is just like this." But here's some stuff that you might look to for vibes.
B	<i>Barbarians</i>（电视剧），Andreas Heckmann 等，Gaumont Germany，2020-2022
B	<i>The Bear and the Nightingale</i> (book; and to a lesser extent the whole <i>Winternight</i> trilogy), Katherine Arden, Del Rey, 2017
B	<i>The Chronicles of Prydain</i> (book series), Lloyd Alexander; Holt, Reinhart, and Winston; 1964-1968
B	<i>The Dark is Rising Sequence</i> (book series), Susan Cooper, Random House, 1965-1977
B	<i>The Demon Cycle</i> (book series), Peter V. Brett, Penguin Random House, 2010-2017
B	<i>Farseer</i>（书三部曲），Robin Hobb，Spectra，1995-1997
B	<i>The First Law</i>（书系列），Joe Abercrombie，Orbit Books，2006-至今
B	<i>The Hobbit</i>（书），J.R.R. Tolkien，George Allen & Unwin，1937
B	<i>King of Dragon Pass</i> (video game), David Dunham, A Sharp, 1999 (or anything else related to the Glorantha setting by Greg Stafford (so I'm told))

P	The following influenced or inspired certain specific elements of <i>Stonetop</i>, or resonate strongly with some of its themes. Maybe they'll inspire you, too.

H3	Caveat emptor
P	以上全部都相关，并可能作为灵感有用，但它们并不一定都好。
P	And some of the creators held and espoused hurtful beliefs, which permeates their work. Others have done or been accused of terrible things. People, like art and our consumption of it, are complicated.
